page_title: POR 6-1 SWI | Portugal v Switzerland 06/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The resulting corner from Vitinha (Portugal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+4' Good defending. Vitinha (Portugal) tries to find Cristiano Ronaldo inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Corner kick. Portugal will have an opportunity.

90+2' 6 - 1 Raphael Guerreiro passes to Rafael Leao (Portugal), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes inside the right post. Fabulous goal! The score is 6:1.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Noah Okafor (Switzerland) heads on.
89' Substitution. Breel Embolo did his best and is replaced by Ardon Jashari (Switzerland).
87' Fernando Santos has decided to make a change. Rafael Leao (Portugal) replaces Bruno Fernandes.
84' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
82' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ruben Neves (Portugal) comes onto the pitch so that Bernardo Silva can be given a rest.
81' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
81' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

80' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Switzerland have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal).
76' It looks like Eray Comert (Switzerland) saw red with that tackle. Cesar Arturo Ramos won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Portugal are awarded a free kick.
75' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) is brought on as a substitute for Joao Felix.
74' Fernando Santos has decided to substitute Otavio and he is replaced by Vitinha (Portugal).
74' Today's match ends for Goncalo Ramos who will be replaced by Ricardo Horta (Portugal).
71' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) sends it out of play.

71' Denis Zakaria (Switzerland) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Switzerland.
70' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Bruno Fernandes, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
68' A pass by Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
67' 5 - 1 Goal! Joao Felix gets to the ball, slips Goncalo Ramos (Portugal) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 5:1.
66' Substitution. Noah Okafor (Switzerland) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ruben Vargas walks off.
63' Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
61' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

61' Good clearance! Denis Zakaria (Switzerland) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Switzerland will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' Yellow card. Eray Comert (Switzerland) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
58' 4 - 1 Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound after the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp shot! It's a goal!
57' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
55' 4 - 0 GOAL! Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) runs onto a pass from Goncalo Ramos after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 4:0.
54' Here is a change. Djibril Sow is going off and Murat Yakin gives the last tactical orders to Haris Seferovic (Switzerland).
54' Denis Zakaria (Switzerland) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Remo Freuler.
54' Pepe (Portugal) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) will take a corner kick.
53' A nice individual effort by Joao Felix (Portugal) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Portugal are awarded a corner kick.
51' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Diogo Dalot laid the ball off to Goncalo Ramos (Portugal), who shot from close range into the right side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
49' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
48' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Portugal have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Murat Yakin has made a change at the break. Eray Comert (Switzerland) has come on in place of Fabian Schar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) tries to find Xherdan Shaqiri, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
45+3' Raphael Guerreiro (Portugal) collects a pass and strikes from about 23 metres out. It's a poor attempt which flies well over the bar.
45+3' Bernardo Silva (Portugal) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

45+2' Diogo Dalot (Portugal) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. The ball is out of play. Portugal will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Joao Felix, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
43' A quickly taken corner by Portugal.
43' Fabian Schar (Switzerland) will miss the next game.
43' Fabian Schar (Switzerland) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Arturo Ramos had an easy-decision to make.

43' Goncalo Ramos (Portugal) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Yann Sommer anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner. Portugal will take a corner kick.
41' Otavio (Portugal) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle for a foul.

38' Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diogo Costa intercepts the ball. Remo Freuler (Switzerland) tries to nod in a rebound. His close-range effort is denied by the goalkeeper, who pulls off a stunning save.
35' A cross by Joao Felix (Portugal) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
33' 2 - 0 Gooal! Bruno Fernandes takes over corner duties. Pepe (Portugal) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 2:0.
33' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
32' Joao Felix (Portugal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play and Portugal manage to earn a corner.
31' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
31' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
30' Diogo Costa reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) towards the bottom right corner. The referee signals a corner kick to Switzerland.
29' Ruben Dias (Portugal) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Arturo Ramos interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick to Switzerland.
28' Otavio (Portugal) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
26' Fabian Schar (Switzerland) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' Fabian Schar (Switzerland) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
22' Goncalo Ramos (Portugal) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.

21' Otavio (Portugal) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the inside of the left post, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort.
20' Remo Freuler (Switzerland) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Arturo Ramos no option but to blow his whistle.
17' 1 - 0 Joao Felix feeds the ball through to Goncalo Ramos (Portugal), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
17' It could have been a good chance to score! Bernardo Silva (Portugal) fails to release Goncalo Ramos with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
14' The Portugal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Portugal will have a goal kick.
8' Cesar Arturo Ramos couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pepe (Portugal) and blew his whistle.
6' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) takes the corner with a short pass.
5' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Switzerland win a corner.
3' Flag up against Goncalo Ramos (Portugal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
2' Joao Felix (Portugal) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Bruno Fernandes, who fails to shoot.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Switzerland will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Cesar Arturo Ramos.
